Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified Prince Nikolaus Wilhelm of Nassau’s mother by conflating two different Princess Paulines of Württemberg. They shifted to “Pauline Therese of Württemberg” (Queen of Württemberg, born in Riga, Russian Empire) instead of the correct Pauline Friederike Marie of Württemberg (a German princess). This led them to treat Riga/Russian Empire as the mother’s “country of origin,” rather than her actual dynastic/national origin (German), and subsequent steps reinforced this misidentification.
